_doc: Forest set pieces, round 4 (ADR-0053): props of the Dunmore Timber truck depot (w4_logging_truck_depot), a logging company's truck shop deep in the timber. Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_wild4_depot.py -> models/props/<id>[_worn|_destroyed].glb; catalog tools/assetgen/blender_catalogs/props_wild4_depot.py. Materials are shared sets (no new ones). size = [width x, height y, depth z] in metres (Godot axes, front +Z); PoiBuilder's collision box is the size centred over the origin. Floor props stand on their origin with their depth centred on it (back = half the depth); the truck board hangs with its origin on the wall plane. Vehicles face +Z (the cab at the front).

defs.name: Loaded Log Truck
defs.description: A conventional-cab log truck in company green, hitched to a pole trailer and loaded with long fir: bunks and stakes, binder chains cinched over the load, mud flaps and a headache rack behind the cab (worn: tyres soft, a window out, moss on the load).

defs.name: Log Truck Tractor
defs.description: The tractor unit of a log truck without its trailer: long hood, sleeperless cab, twin stacks, a headache rack and the fifth-wheel plate over the drive axles (worn: the hood up, a wheel off the steer axle).

defs.name: Four-Post Truck Lift
defs.description: A heavy four-post drive-on lift: yellow posts, two diamond-plate runways raised to chest height, the crossbeams, cables and the power unit on the front post (worn: one runway dropped to its lock).

defs.name: Weighbridge
defs.description: A truck scale set flush in the yard: a long steel deck of checker plate on a concrete pit, steel ramps at both ends, the load cell junction box and a painted stop line (worn: the deck rusted through at one corner).

defs.name: Diesel Pump
defs.description: A squat red commercial diesel pump: a mechanical register behind scratched glass, a long hose on the hook and a high-flow nozzle (worn: the hose cut, the glass starred; destroyed: knocked off its base).

defs.name: Diesel Storage Tank
defs.description: A ten-thousand-litre horizontal steel tank on concrete saddles: a ladder up its end, the fill neck and vent on top, the outlet valve and pipe running off to the pumps and DIESEL - NO SMOKING stencilled on its side.

defs.name: Pump Island
defs.description: A raised concrete pump island with steel-capped ends and two yellow bollards.

defs.name: Log Deck Stack
defs.description: A tall deck of long fir and larch logs stacked five courses high between steel stakes on skids, the ends sawn and spray-marked by the scaler (worn: moss on the top course, the ends checked grey).

defs.name: Low Log Pile
defs.description: A low pile of cull logs two courses high on skid logs, chocked at the ends: low enough to scramble over.

defs.name: Log Loader
defs.description: A yellow wheel loader fitted with log forks and a top clamp: big lugged tyres, an articulated frame, the cab cage and the counterweight, the forks lowered to the ground (worn: tyres flat, the cab glass gone).

defs.name: Welding Cart
defs.description: A two-wheeled welding cart: oxygen and acetylene bottles chained in, the regulators and twin hose coiled on the handle, and a stick welder on the shelf with its leads.

defs.name: Parts Shelf
defs.description: Heavy steel shelving full of truck parts: oil and air filters in their boxes, fan belts on hooks, brake shoes, hose reels and a bin of bolts (worn: half picked over; destroyed: pulled over and empty).

defs.name: Dispatch Console
defs.description: The dispatcher's console: a steel desk with a mobile base station radio, its desk microphone and a battery charger, the company channel list taped under the shelf, a clipboard of load sheets and a desk lamp (worn: coffee rings, the logbook open).

defs.name: Pit Planks
defs.description: Thick oak planks laid across an inspection pit to cover it, scuffed with boot prints and oil, the near end pulled back.

defs.name: Truck Board
defs.description: The dispatch board: a whiteboard ruled into trucks and landings, magnets for the six trucks, the last loads written in and trucks 4 and 6 circled twice in red.

defs.name: Truck Tyre Stack
defs.description: Three heavy log-truck tyres stacked flat, the top one on a steel rim.
